query.description: Review, blocked, and waiting task counts aggregated for every active project.
query.sql: SELECT p.name AS project, CASE p.name WHEN 'AnimeRPG · Astral Engine' THEN 'AnimeRPG' WHEN 'Sports Play LLM Research' THEN 'Sports Play' WHEN 'Summer 2027 Internship Research' THEN 'Summer 2027' ELSE p.name END AS display_project, COUNT(t.id) AS frontier_tasks FROM projects AS p LEFT JOIN tasks AS t ON t.project_id = p.id AND t.status IN ('review', 'blocked', 'waiting') WHERE p.desired = 1 AND p.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY frontier_tasks DESC, p.name ASC;
metric_definitions: Frontier tasks are durable task rows currently in review, blocked, or waiting for one active project.
The frontier is point-in-time operational state, not an estimate of unique user problems or business value.

blocks.body:
## Executive Summary

Build an **evidence-driven Project Operating System**; the **818-task frontier** makes review and promotion the first priority.

**Findings:** [Code agents](https://cursor.com/blog/agent-best-practices) add bounded evidence, [vertical agents](https://decagon.ai/product/aop) add expert gates, and [creative/research agents](https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/53718574533395-Viewing-and-downloading-an-asset-s-lineage) add lineage and context.

**Next steps:** Trust layer → Summer/Every pilots → reuse in Sports, AnimeRPG, and Retainage.

**Further Questions:** Which tasks are stale; which pilot lifts acceptance fastest?

**Caveats and Assumptions:** Design patterns, snapshot counts, and judgment—not causal impact or ROI.
